prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Browse through companions to find the perfect fit for your desktop."]
1: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Practice hiding, summoning, and speaking to your pet before heading to your desktop.", "Try Summon Command"]
2: ["Play Pet Care Mini-Game", "Feed Your Pet While It Loads", "Interactive mini-game to keep your new companion happy during preparation."]
3: ["Secure Your Companion Account First", "Link your account now to ensure your custom pet is safe across all desktop devices."]
4: ["Use well-lit, single-subject photos for optimal 3D pet rendering results."]
5: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Press Option/Alt + Pet to open quick interactions, or access settings anytime from your system tray menu."]
6: ["Crafting 3D Companion Assets", "Building animations and textures. This usually takes under 3 minutes."]
7: ["Automatic Cloud Save Protected"]
8: ["Select Your Onboarding Path", "Pick a pre-made pet companion or create your own custom companion from photos."]
9: ["Launch Pet to Desktop"]
